clue.text: Animals turning on another duck abruptly

indicators.note: turning tells us the word for the animals is to be read from its last letter back to its first

parts.note: cats are animals
another animal of the same kind, a cat
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so the round letter O

explanation.surface: A duck, panicked by circling animals, makes a sudden exit.
explanation.definitionFit: Staccato is the musical term for notes played short and detached, hence clipped or sudden.

clue.text: Call out second best

parts.note: the cream of anything is its best part

explanation.surface: Shouting out who came runner-up in a contest.
explanation.definitionFit: To call out loudly or shriek is to yell in alarm, a piercing cry.

clue.text: Announcements about fighting for grants

indicators.note: about here means going round, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: ads are announcements, short for advertisements
war is fighting

explanation.surface: News reports of battles being waged over funding.
explanation.definitionFit: Awards are sums or prizes conferred, the same as grants of money.

clue.text: A spice many adore

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so a crossword way of saying many
to adore is to love

explanation.surface: A seasoning that lots of cooks are mad about.
explanation.definitionFit: The dried flower bud of a tropical tree, used as a pungent kitchen seasoning.

clue.text: Senator badly affected by treachery

indicators.note: badly affected says the letters of the word before it are disturbed and reordered

explanation.surface: A politician hurt by betrayal from colleagues.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason is betrayal of one's country, a form of disloyalty.

clue.text: Craftily settled?

parts.note: read 'craftily' not as cunningly but as on a craft, a ship or plane, where one has settled in

explanation.surface: Someone cunningly arranged or established.
explanation.definitionFit: Passengers on board a vessel or aircraft are settled on that craft.

clue.text: A literary supporter!

parts.note: a supporter suggests a fan of literature, but here it is a physical support holding up volumes

explanation.surface: A devoted fan of books and writers.
explanation.definitionFit: A wall shelf holds up a row of volumes, propping up literature physically.

clue.text: They feel a girl will turn in neat results

indicators.note: in places the girl's name inside the rearranged letters
results suggests the letters of neat are the outcome of a reshuffle
will turn means the girl's name is read backwards

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl spinning round gets tidy outcomes, and somebody senses something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'results' rearranges NEAT to ANTE; 'will turn' reverses ANNE to ENNA, which goes inside: ANT(ENNA)E.
explanation.definitionFit: Insects' feelers are sensory organs on the head that touch and sense.

clue.text: The lawlessness of the underworld "family"

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and a name for the underworld itself
in biological classification, family and order are ranks, so a crossword swap

explanation.surface: Crime bosses of the gangland 'family' cause disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted 'family' suggests a mafia clan; it is really a taxonomic rank standing in for ORDER.
explanation.definitionFit: A breakdown of public order is a state of riot and anarchy.

clue.text: Rush around a boy, showing thought

indicators.note: around tells us the plant word encloses the other pieces

parts.note: a rush is a reed-like plant, so reed
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A hurried trip around a lad, showing consideration.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reasoned has been logically argued, showing careful deliberation.

clue.text: Stars made to be so

indicators.note: made suggests the following letters are formed into something new by rearrangement

explanation.surface: Celebrities shaped to be just so.
explanation.walkthrough: BOOTES is a northern constellation, the Herdsman, containing the bright star Arcturus.
explanation.definitionFit: A constellation is a group of stars seen as a figure in the sky.

clue.text: A river in the far north of Russia

indicators.note: in tells us the letters are found within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A watercourse up in the remote Russian Arctic.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a Russian river, but the answer flows through Florence in Italy; it sits inside 'fAR NOrth'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arno is an Italian waterway running through Florence and Pisa.

clue.text: He posts a key item of kitchen equipment

parts.note: D is one of the musical keys, as in D major
a dresser is a kitchen sideboard with shelves for crockery

explanation.surface: Someone advertises an essential piece of kitchen furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: The person who directs or sends a letter is its sender, one who posts mail.

clue.text: The Spaniard when older has no need of one

indicators.note: has no need of tells us a piece is dropped from the word before

parts.note: senior means older
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An elderly Spaniard has no use for a single thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Señor is the Spanish title for a man, so it can stand for a Spanish gentleman.

clue.text: To a certain degree in deep water

definitions.meaning: the phrase 'in the ...' means mostly, for the most part
an old poetic word for the open sea

explanation.walkthrough: 'in' does double duty in the surface: it completes the idiom 'in the main' while sitting as a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The high seas are poetically called the main, and 'in the main' means largely.

clue.text: Seamen or crooked characters taking all in

parts.note: AB stands for able seaman, so seamen are ABs
bent is slang for crooked or corrupt

explanation.surface: Sailors or shady types soaking up everything around them.
explanation.definitionFit: An absorbent material soaks up liquid, drawing everything into itself.

clue.text: Love to talk about egghead's work

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the round letter O

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so the word for talk goes round a letter

parts.note: to prate is to chatter or talk idly
the head of the word egg is its first letter, E

explanation.surface: A romantic urge to discuss the work of an intellectual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egghead' looks like a brainy person, but it is taken literally as the head of 'egg'.
explanation.definitionFit: To operate a machine is to run it, making it function or go.

clue.text: Note given to workman building a parapet

parts.note: B is a musical note
an artisan is a skilled workman

explanation.surface: A memo handed to a craftsman constructing a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: A bartizan is a small overhanging turret on a battlement or castle wall.

clue.text: Industrial action that's quite out of the ordinary

explanation.surface: A walkout that is quite unusual.
explanation.definitionFit: Going on strike is a stoppage by workers; striking also means remarkable.

clue.text: This entertainer is a drawer, note

parts.note: one who draws pictures is an artist
E is one of the musical notes A to G

explanation.surface: A performer who also sketches, as a note tells us.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawer' suggests a sliding box in a chest; it means someone who draws.
explanation.definitionFit: An artiste is a professional performer such as a singer or dancer.

clue.text: Black bone artefact

indicators.note: an artefact is something crafted, so the letters of the word before are refashioned

explanation.surface: A dark carved object made from bone.
explanation.definitionFit: Ebon is a poetic word for dark as ebony wood.

clue.text: A row involving some mastiffs

indicators.note: involving some says the answer is a portion of the letters in the next word

explanation.surface: A squabble between a few big dogs.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiff is a petty quarrel, a minor argument.

clue.text: Beef for winning team?

definitions.meaning: a lean cut of meat from the upper thigh of a cow
the team on top, read as two words

explanation.surface: Meat as a prize for the champions.
explanation.definitionFit: Topside is a cut of beef from the hindquarter; split, it is the side on top.

clue.text: What shopkeepers want is practice!

explanation.surface: Retailers rely on regular buyers, and that is habit!
explanation.definitionFit: Custom is patronage from buyers, and also a habitual way of doing things.

clue.text: This enzyme for vitality's popular

parts.note: pep is vitality, plus the possessive S
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: Something boosting energy is in demand.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepsin is a digestive protein in the stomach that breaks down food.

clue.text: Judge line about right

indicators.note: about here means encircling, so the word for line wraps a letter

parts.note: a tier is a row or line

explanation.surface: A magistrate draws a line around what is correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A trier is one who tries a case, someone who hears and decides it.

clue.text: Work and prune to shape at the appropriate time

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: shape asks us to mould the preceding letters into a new form

explanation.surface: Doing the job and cutting back trees into form at just the right moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shape' rearranges PRUNETO into PORTUNE after OP.
explanation.definitionFit: Opportune means coming at a well-timed or convenient moment.

clue.text: Sally gets around quietly but fast

indicators.note: gets around shows one word encircling the other

parts.note: a sally is a sudden sortie, a raid
p is piano, the musical direction for softly

explanation.surface: A woman named Sally sneaks round in silence yet at speed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sally' looks like a woman's name; it is a military sortie.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapid means swift or quick.

clue.text: Agreeably dressed?

parts.note: agreeably hints at being well matched or convenient, while dressed hints at wearing formal clothes

explanation.surface: Wearing pleasant clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Being right for someone, or clad in a jacket and trousers that match.

clue.text: Arguments taking place in newly-formed sides

indicators.note: in tells us one piece goes inside the other
newly-formed suggests the letters before it are made into a fresh order

parts.note: to put is to place

explanation.surface: Rows take place between factions recently set up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'newly-formed' turns SIDES into DISES; 'in' puts PUT inside: DIS(PUT)ES.
explanation.definitionFit: Disputes are quarrels or debates, disagreements.

clue.text: Deny seeing directions by the entry

parts.note: N and E are compass directions, north and east
a gate is an entrance

explanation.surface: Refusing to see where things are going near the doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: To negate is to contradict or nullify something.

clue.text: The executor had means to dispose of

indicators.note: dispose here means arrange anew, so the letters before it are set out differently

explanation.surface: The person handling a will had the funds to get rid of.
explanation.walkthrough: 'executor' suggests the lawyer handling a will; it is one who executes people, the axeman.
explanation.definitionFit: A headsman was the official axeman who beheaded the condemned.
